title: Talend Business Intelligence - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • +2 years significant experience as a Business Intelligence;
  • Experience with Talend;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • B2 English is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Especialista em n8n / Automação Avançada
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em n8n / Automação Avançada. O profissional irá atuar em ambientes produtivos críticos, com domínio profundo de nós e gatilhos (chunking, retries, desacoplamento de lógica), expressões e manipulação avançada de dados, integrações robustas com APIs REST/GraphQL, LLMs e SaaS corporativos, além de conhecimento sólido em banco de dados e filas do n8n .


Requisitos Obrigatórios - deve ter experiência em:


  • Observabilidade (logs, tracing, alertas);
  • Operação em Kubernetes com workers escaláveis;
  • Versionamento de workflows;
  • Export/import automatizado;
  • Criação de runbooks de recuperação;
  • Biblioteca de sub-workflows reutilizáveis;
  • Aplicação de SDLC/ALM no n8n;
  • Definição e monitoramento de SLI/SLO para filas;
  • Implementação de CRUD de workflows com triggers básicos.


Conhecimentos Adicionais (Diferenciais)


  • JavaScript: Capacidade de criar funções personalizadas dentro do n8n (Code Node) para manipulação complexa de objetos e arrays.
  • Python: Conhecimento para scripts de automação, processamento de dados (Pandas/NumPy) ou integração com modelos de IA.
  • SQL: Noções básicas para consulta e inserção de dados em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Ferramentas de IA: Experiência integrando automações com OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic ou modelos locais.


Perfil Desejado


  • Proatividade para buscar soluções documentadas em APIs de terceiros.
  • Organização para documentar os fluxos criados.
  • Foco em escalabilidade (pensar em como o workflow se comporta com 10 ou 10.000 execuções).


Contratação PJ.

Vaga prioritariamente remota, podendo ocorrer visitas eventuais no cliente e/ou escritório da Practia.

title: Especialista em n8n / Automação Avançada
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em n8n / Automação Avançada. O profissional irá atuar em ambientes produtivos críticos, com domínio profundo de nós e gatilhos (chunking, retries, desacoplamento de lógica), expressões e manipulação avançada de dados, integrações robustas com APIs REST/GraphQL, LLMs e SaaS corporativos, além de conhecimento sólido em banco de dados e filas do n8n .


Requisitos Obrigatórios - deve ter experiência em:


  • Observabilidade (logs, tracing, alertas);
  • Operação em Kubernetes com workers escaláveis;
  • Versionamento de workflows;
  • Export/import automatizado;
  • Criação de runbooks de recuperação;
  • Biblioteca de sub-workflows reutilizáveis;
  • Aplicação de SDLC/ALM no n8n;
  • Definição e monitoramento de SLI/SLO para filas;
  • Implementação de CRUD de workflows com triggers básicos.


Conhecimentos Adicionais (Diferenciais)


  • JavaScript: Capacidade de criar funções personalizadas dentro do n8n (Code Node) para manipulação complexa de objetos e arrays.
  • Python: Conhecimento para scripts de automação, processamento de dados (Pandas/NumPy) ou integração com modelos de IA.
  • SQL: Noções básicas para consulta e inserção de dados em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Ferramentas de IA: Experiência integrando automações com OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic ou modelos locais.


Perfil Desejado


  • Proatividade para buscar soluções documentadas em APIs de terceiros.
  • Organização para documentar os fluxos criados.
  • Foco em escalabilidade (pensar em como o workflow se comporta com 10 ou 10.000 execuções).


Contratação PJ.

Vaga prioritariamente remota, podendo ocorrer visitas eventuais no cliente e/ou escritório da Practia.

title: Engagement Manager (Remote) - Brazil
description:
We are looking for a candidate with experience in Professional Services or customer-facing technical project management roles, preferably within the CRM space (Salesforce, Dynamics, or HubSpot). The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly with clients, gathering and analyzing requirements, and translating business needs into clear application and customer requirements.

The candidate should be able to produce design documentation based on business requirements and collaborate closely with developers to define technical requirements. Experience with programming or coding is strongly preferred, as it enables the candidate to create stronger technical design documents and effectively bridge the gap between business and engineering teams.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Understand the business requirements and processes of customers and translate them to specific functional specifications
  • Facilitating the negotiation of requirements amongst multiple stakeholders
  • Design, manage and conduct client interviews to validate the proposed solutions with requirements
  • Maintain requirements tracking to keep tight control over evolving business requirements and scope changes
  • Become a solution expert who can guide customers on how best to realize value from Magentrix products
  • Facilitating design sessions with the solution architect to define the solution, specifications, and scope.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet delivery and budget targets
  • Coordinate with other Engagement Managers to conduct resource planning and ensure that the project members are utilized effectively.


QUALIFICATIONS


  • University degree in engineering, science or technology field or equivalent
  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an asset
  • Salesforce or other CRM certifications is an asset
  • Experience in preparing solution proposals and detailed functional requirements in consultation with clients and partners


LEAD EXPERIENCE


  • Knowledge of CRM application implementation (Salesforce, Dynamics, or HubSpot)
  • Minimum 3-5 years working as a business analyst/system analyst in a technology setting
  • Able to work under stress and conflicting timelines when necessary
  • Strong interpersonal skills and communicates clearly and concisely (written and verbal)
  • Flexible, energetic, and able to work well with others in a client-focused, innovative and cross-functional environment
  • Proficiency in Google Apps, Project management tools, bug tracking & collaboration tools.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills balanced with common sense and initiative
  • Results-oriented and process-driven, with high expectations of self and team
  • Ability to set expectations with clients and promptly follow through to progress implementations effectively and in a timely manner
  • Ability to effectively receive and communicate feedback

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.



Engenheiro de dados (Inglês fluente)


Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior com inglês fluente qualificado com uma base sólida em desenvolvimento baseado em SQL. Essa função se concentrará na criação e manutenção de pipelines de dados usando o PySpark, com SQL como a linguagem de codificação principal. O candidato também terá uma boa compreensão das estruturas de modelagem de dados (como modelagem dimensional Kimball) e experiência no suporte a datawarehouses e data marts.


Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados em lote usando o PySpark (focado em SQL)

Escreva e otimize consultas SQL complexas para dar suporte à lógica de negócios e às necessidades de relatórios

Entenda os requisitos de forma autônoma e traduza para código

Transforme e integre dados de diversas fontes em tabelas Iceberg e Snowflake

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de data marts e conjuntos de dados selecionados para consumo comercial

Colabore com analistas de negócios para entender as necessidades de dados

Monitore e gerencie trabalhos de dados em execução no AWS EMR orquestrados pelo Airflow, aproveitando o S3, o Glue e outros serviços da AWS

Garanta a qualidade, a consistência e o desempenho dos dados em todo o pipeline




Qualificações preferenciais

Experiência na criação e gerenciamento de data marts

Exposição ao Airflow ou outras ferramentas de orquestração

Familiaridade com ferramentas de infraestrutura como código, como o Terraform

Compreensão dos padrões ODS (Operational Data Store) e arquitetura de data lake

Experiência com Bitbucket (ou qualquer ferramenta git semelhante)

Experiência/compreensão de Jenkins



Habilidades Comportamentais e Competências:

Fluência em inglês

Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência prática em engenharia de dados codificando consultas SQL complexas

Experiência comprovada em SQL – incluindo junções, agregações, funções de janela e ajuste de desempenho

Experiência prática com o PySpark, particularmente com o Spark SQL

Familiaridade com os serviços de dados da AWS (por exemplo, EMR, S3, Glue)

Compreensão de estruturas de modelagem de dados, incluindo a metodologia Kimball

Experiência de trabalho com Snowflake ou data warehouses em nuvem semelhantes

Conhecimento do Apache Iceberg ou formatos de tabela semelhantes (por exemplo, Delta Lake, Hudi)





TRABALHE NA MINSAIT


  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).
  • Vale Refeição no cartão Flash Benefícios.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Integramos o Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index (GEI) 2021 em termos de diversidade e igualdade de gênero.

title: Arquiteto de software
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em soluções personalizadas e outsourcing, conectando talentos a projetos desafiadores em grandes organizações.

No momento, estamos conduzindo um processo seletivo para um cliente do setor de conformidade fiscal, que atua com soluções de missão crítica, alto volume transacional e forte exigência de performance e confiabilidade.


Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Software que atue de forma estratégica, apoiando a evolução de arquiteturas modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a eventos.



Principais responsabilidades:


  • Analisar arquiteturas existentes do cliente e propor melhorias com foco em escalabilidade, performance e alta disponibilidade.
  • Atuar no desenho e evolução de sistemas distribuídos com alto volume de dados e transações.
  • Desenvolver e automatizar testes de performance utilizando ferramentas como K6 e Artillery.
  • Identificar, analisar e apoiar a resolução de incidentes e gargalos em aplicações de alta volumetria.
  • Participar da definição e implementação de estratégias de mensageria e streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Event Hub).
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, aplicando CQRS e design patterns avançados.
  • Atuar em ambientes containerizados, utilizando Docker e Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
  • Contribuir com decisões técnicas sobre bancos de dados (PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB), considerando desempenho e escalabilidade.
  • Implementar estratégias de cache, observabilidade e otimização de APIs.
  • Colaborar com times internos do cliente (engenharia, infraestrutura e DevOps), garantindo entregas de alta qualidade.



Requisitos técnicos:


  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Software ou Engenheiro de Software Sênior.
  • Forte domínio de .NET / C# e práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.
  • Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e alto tráfego (milhões de transações).
  • Conhecimento sólido em Docker e Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
  • Experiência com mensageria e streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Event Hub).
  • Domínio de arquitetura orientada a eventos, CQRS e padrões avançados de arquitetura.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e testes de performance (Grafana, Prometheus, K6, Artillery).
  • Atuação com pipelines de CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab ou similares).
  • Experiência em cloud AWS e/ou Azure (Lambda, Functions, SNS/SQS, CosmosDB, PostgreSQL, entre outros).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para comunicação técnica.



Diferenciais:


  • Experiência prévia em projetos do setor tributário, financeiro ou regulado.
  • Vivência em ambientes de missão crítica e alta complexidade.
  • Perfil consultivo, com boa comunicação e visão sistêmica.



O que oferecemos:


  • Atuação em projeto estratégico, com alto impacto no negócio do cliente.
  • Modelo de outsourcing estruturado, com acompanhamento próximo e suporte da nossa equipe.
  • Ambiente técnico desafiador, com espaço para influência arquitetural e decisões estratégicas.



Benefícios Kbase:


Benefícios:


Aqui a gente acredita que trabalhar bem começa com cuidar das pessoas. Por isso, nossos benefícios são pensados para apoiar sua saúde, seu bem-estar e o seu crescimento


  • Auxílio Alimentação ou Refeição : R$ 31,50 por dia em um cartão flexível para você cuidar da sua alimentação com mais liberdade no dia a dia.
  • Plano de Saúde : contamos com subsídio da empresa para seu plano de saúde, para você cuidar da sua saúde com mais tranquilidade.
  • Day Off : um dia só seu, pra descansar, comemorar ou simplesmente não fazer nada
  • Descanso Remunerado : acreditamos no equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Auxílio Home Office : uma ajudinha pra deixar seu home office mais confortável e funcional.
  • Auxílio Mobilidade: apoio para o seu deslocamento em oportunidades híbridas ou presenciais, facilitando sua rotina.
  • Plataforma Alura : acesso a uma das maiores plataformas de cursos do mercado pra você aprender no seu ritmo
  • Programas de Desenvolvimento : iniciativas pensadas para impulsionar sua carreira.
  • Feedbacks Cíclicos : conversas frequentes, transparentes e construtivas sobre sua evolução.
  • Análise Comportamental : ferramentas que ajudam no autoconhecimento e no desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Desenvolvimento por Competências : seu crescimento acontece a partir do que você tem de melhor

title: Arquiteto de software
description:
Somos uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em soluções personalizadas e outsourcing, conectando talentos a projetos desafiadores em grandes organizações.

No momento, estamos conduzindo um processo seletivo para um cliente do setor de conformidade fiscal, que atua com soluções de missão crítica, alto volume transacional e forte exigência de performance e confiabilidade.


Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Software que atue de forma estratégica, apoiando a evolução de arquiteturas modernas, escaláveis e orientadas a eventos.



Principais responsabilidades:


  • Analisar arquiteturas existentes do cliente e propor melhorias com foco em escalabilidade, performance e alta disponibilidade.
  • Atuar no desenho e evolução de sistemas distribuídos com alto volume de dados e transações.
  • Desenvolver e automatizar testes de performance utilizando ferramentas como K6 e Artillery.
  • Identificar, analisar e apoiar a resolução de incidentes e gargalos em aplicações de alta volumetria.
  • Participar da definição e implementação de estratégias de mensageria e streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Event Hub).
  • Trabalhar com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos, aplicando CQRS e design patterns avançados.
  • Atuar em ambientes containerizados, utilizando Docker e Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
  • Contribuir com decisões técnicas sobre bancos de dados (PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB), considerando desempenho e escalabilidade.
  • Implementar estratégias de cache, observabilidade e otimização de APIs.
  • Colaborar com times internos do cliente (engenharia, infraestrutura e DevOps), garantindo entregas de alta qualidade.



Requisitos técnicos:


  • Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Software ou Engenheiro de Software Sênior.
  • Forte domínio de .NET / C# e práticas modernas de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.
  • Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e alto tráfego (milhões de transações).
  • Conhecimento sólido em Docker e Kubernetes (AKS/EKS).
  • Experiência com mensageria e streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Event Hub).
  • Domínio de arquitetura orientada a eventos, CQRS e padrões avançados de arquitetura.
  • Experiência com monitoramento e testes de performance (Grafana, Prometheus, K6, Artillery).
  • Atuação com pipelines de CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitLab ou similares).
  • Experiência em cloud AWS e/ou Azure (Lambda, Functions, SNS/SQS, CosmosDB, PostgreSQL, entre outros).
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado para comunicação técnica.



Diferenciais:


  • Experiência prévia em projetos do setor tributário, financeiro ou regulado.
  • Vivência em ambientes de missão crítica e alta complexidade.
  • Perfil consultivo, com boa comunicação e visão sistêmica.

title: Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain
description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager – SAP / Supply Chain to lead and deliver SAP Supply Chain programs and projects in complex, global environments.

This role requires strong experience managing SAP initiatives (ECC and S/4HANA) , coordinating cross‑functional and multicultural teams, and driving end‑to‑end delivery across Supply Chain, Logistics, Manufacturing, and ERP landscapes .


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP Supply Chain projects and programs (ECC and S/4HANA) from initiation to closure.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, risks, and quality across multiple workstreams.
  • Coordinate global, cross‑functional teams (IT, business, vendors, and integrators).
  • Drive delivery of SAP initiatives across Supply Chain domains (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Warehousing).
  • Act as main interface between business stakeholders and IT teams .
  • Apply project governance, PMO standards, and delivery methodologies .
  • Support SAP S/4HANA assessments, upgrades, rollouts, and transformations .
  • Manage dependencies across SAP and non‑SAP systems (Oracle, legacy platforms, integrations).
  • Oversee testing phases (SIT, UAT), cutover, go‑live, and hypercare.
  • Ensure executive‑level communication, reporting, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Contribute to portfolio management , roadmap definition, and prioritization.
  • Identify risks, resolve conflicts, and ensure successful outcomes.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Solid experience in IT Project Management , with strong focus on SAP .
  • Proven experience managing SAP Supply Chain projects/programs .
  • Solid understanding of SAP ECC and S/4HANA landscapes.
  • Experience working with global / multi‑country teams .
  • Strong knowledge of project management best practices (waterfall, agile, hybrid).
  • Experience coordinating vendors, system integrators, and offshore teams .
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English (mandatory); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.


Certifications (Required or Preferred)

  • PMP® (mandatory or strong plus)
  • PMI‑ACP®, CSM®, ITIL® (nice to have)
  • SAP project or program management experience highly valued


Nice to Have

  • Experience as SAP Program Manager or Portfolio Lead .
  • Exposure to Supply Chain processes (Logistics, Manufacturing, Planning).
  • Experience with S/4HANA transformation programs .
  • Background in consumer goods, manufacturing, agribusiness, or industrial sectors .
  • PMO setup or governance model implementation experience.


Keywords for ATS

Project Manager, SAP Project Manager, SAP Program Manager, SAP Supply Chain, S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP Logistics, SAP Manufacturing, SAP SCM, Portfolio Management, PMO, PMP, Agile, Global Projects, ERP Transformation

title: Strategic Operations Project Coordinator
description:
Strategic Operations Project Coordinator


We are currently hiring for a division which focuses on providing services to immigration law firms across the United States.


The Strategic Operations Project Coordinator will serve as a key support resource to operational leadership, combining elements of project coordination, business analysis, and administrative management. This role is responsible for managing small-to-medium projects, conducting research and analysis, building documentation, performing system testing, and offloading administrative tasks from senior leaders to improve organizational efficiency. The ideal candidate will be highly proficient in AI tools and demonstrate strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities

-Project Management

  • Manage and coordinate small-to-medium projects from initiation through completion.
  • Develop project timelines, track milestones, and ensure deliverables are met on schedule.
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders and communicate project status to leadership.
  • Identify and escalate project risks or blockers appropriately.


-Operational Support

  • Offload administrative and analytical tasks from operational leaders including report generation, data compilation, and meeting preparation.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, competitive intelligence, process improvements, and business opportunities.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations, briefing materials, and strategic documents.
  • Support special initiatives and ad-hoc requests from leadership.


-Analysis and Reporting

  • Perform light data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Create and maintain operational reports and dashboards for leadership review.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend efficiency improvements.
  • Synthesize complex information into clear, actionable summaries.


-Documentation and System Testing

  • Build and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials.
  • Conduct system testing for new features, integrations, or process changes.
  • Document test results, identify issues, and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, current, and accessible to appropriate stakeholders.


-AI Tool Utilization

  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, etc.) to enhance productivity and output quality.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI capabilities to operational challenges.
  • Stay current on AI tool developments and best practices.


Qualification

-Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination, business analysis, or administrative support roles
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) in professional contexts
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret data and identify insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to take initiative


-Preferred:

  • Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
  • Experience with business intelligence or data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power Automate, or other Microsoft 365 automation tools
  • Project management certification (PMP, CAPM) or similar credentials

title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist – Interventional Cardiology (Brazil)
description:
About us


BrosMed is the largest balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise in China, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment in 2012, the company has grown to over 1,500 staffs in scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide.


Responsibilities


-Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as POT balloons, Wedge NC scoring balloons, and Alveo CTO balloons.

-Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories.

-Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.

-Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning.

-Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion.

-Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals.

-Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy.

-Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up.

-Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards.



Qualifications


Language proficiency:

High-level command of a local language

the ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters).

Industry background:

Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors;

preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs.

Core qualities:

Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven;

strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes;

excellent communication skills and customer service awareness.

O time de Fulfillment da Shopee gerencia todo o fluxo logístico dos pedidos, desde o armazenamento dos produtos em nossos centros de distribuição até a separação, embalagem e envio ao cliente final. Monitoramos KPIs operacionais em tempo real e realizamos análises de causa para otimizar continuamente o desempenho das operações. O time de Fulfillment é composto por especialistas em armazenagem, logística, expedição e distribuição , trabalhando para garantir que cada pedido seja processado com qualidade e agilidade.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

description:
Buscamos Desenvolvedor(a) Back-End Sênior para atuar em cliente Talent Group. ✨



Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida com Node.js;
  • Domínio de MongoDB;
  • Forte entendimento de APIs REST (e/ou GraphQL);
  • Vivência com Git e pipelines de desenvolvimento.



Soft Skills

  • Mentalidade de dono e foco na entrega de valor;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa em times multidisciplinares;
  • Boa comunicação e organização;
  • Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e de processos;
  • Disposição para seguir os processos de aprovação e documentação da empresa.



Requisitos Desejáveis/Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Neo4J.
  • Conhecimento de Vue.js (para apoio em integrações e colaboração com front-end).
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria ou filas.
  • Experiência com Typescript e NestJS.
  • Familiaridade com containers (Docker) e CI/CD.
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Noções de segurança de APIs e boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.



Atividades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar serviços e APIs utilizando Node.js;
  • Projetar e implementar integrações entre sistemas internos e externos;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados NoSQL, incluindo MongoDB e Neo4J;
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, com foco em performance;
  • Apoiar na definição de arquiteturas, padrões e boas práticas de back-end;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes, revisões e monitoramento;
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de Produto, Front-end, UX e QA;
  • Contribuir ativamente na resolução de problemas, análise de logs e melhorias contínuas.


Contratação : CLT + Benefícios

Modelo de Trabalho : 100% Remoto

title: Analista de Docagem II
description:
A pessoa será responsável pelo planejamento e acompanhamento dos projetos de docagem, incluindo avaliação técnica, gestão de inventário, uso de tecnologias e relacionamento com clientes, embarcações e terceiros. Também apoiará na elaboração de relatórios, estimativas de custos e na identificação de melhorias contínuas nos processos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar e coordenar as atividades de docagem;
  • Avaliar as especificações técnicas dos projetos de docagem;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos de docagem, incluindo cumprimento de prazos, orçamento e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Desenvolver Comunicação e Relacionamento com clientes internos;
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre os projetos de docagem, incluindo análises de progresso e recomendações para melhorias futuras;
  • Realizar gestão de inventário de peças, materiais e equipamentos a serem utilizados durante os projetos de docagem;
  • Desenvolver e manter procedimentos operacionais para garantir a consistência e a qualidade nos processos de docagem;
  • Implementar e supervisionar o uso de tecnologias avançadas, como sistemas de controle e monitoramento e BI;
  • Acompanhar os serviços das empresas terceirizadas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos de docagem;
  • Estabelecer comunicação com as embarcações que irão docar;
  • Participar na elaboração de estimativas de custos para projetos de docagem.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia: Produção, Mecânica, Automação, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou Naval.
  • Experiência na área ou função similar.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Made Simpler

Made Simpler exists to empower small and medium-sized businesses to grow smarter, stronger, and with real impact. We believe opportunity should not be defined by company size or available resources. With the right system in place, any business can compete, scale, and lead.

We are the world’s first Wholesale Marketing Agency , delivering Managed Marketing as a Service (MMaaS), a powerful combination of strategic human expertise and AI acceleration. Our model provides accessible, scalable, and results-driven marketing and revenue engines, leveling the playing field for growing businesses.

About the role

We are looking for a Video Editor with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence tools , capable of creating highly persuasive videos for Social Media, Ads, and institutional content.

This role requires the ability to balance human storytelling with AI efficiency, producing high-quality, scalable, and performance-driven video content.

This is a full time opportunity, 100% remote.

Key Responsibilities

  • Video editing and assembly: transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and cohesive narratives across multiple platforms, including social media, websites, and advertising.
  • Mastery of video editing tools: work with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut Pro (or similar).
  • AI-powered video creation: leverage generative AI platforms to create avatars, videos, and unique visual assets, with a strong focus on tools like Creatify AI.
  • Asset organization and management: maintain efficient organization of files, versions, and workflows using tools such as Notion and Google Drive.
  • Platform optimization: adapt formats, aspect ratios, codecs, and audio levels to maximize performance across platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and paid ads.

Must haves

  • Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to video creation and post-production, such as Midjourney, Creatify AI, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Google Flow, etc.
  • Strong storytelling ability, with a solid grasp of pacing, persuasion, and visual composition.
  • Technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, compression, color correction/grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
  • Intermediate to advanced English

title: Full Stack Engineer, Brazil
description:
About Optibus:

Optibus is a unified software platform revolutionizing public transportation planning, scheduling, and operations in over 7,000 cities worldwide. Using AI, ML, and optimization algorithms, it empowers agencies to design more efficient, equitable, and sustainable transit networks, enhancing passenger access, reducing emissions, and improving driver conditions. With offices globally and a team of 350+ employees, Optibus fosters a collaborative culture centered on innovation, determination, and impact. As the first unicorn in public transportation technology, Optibus is driving the modernization of mass transit to make it the preferred choice for cities and passengers alike.


About the position (role & team):

Optibus is looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer to join our Planning R&D team in the mission of making transportation smarter and more efficient. We're seeking a mid-level engineer with a strong software development background and experience building and maintaining modern web applications.

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Planning Team, you’ll contribute to the development of features and improvements for our mass transportation planning products, collaborating with other engineers, product managers, and designers to create high-quality, user-focused solutions.


Responsibilities :

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain full-stack applications using React, TypeScript in the frontend, and Node.js with TypeScript deployed on K8S in the backend
  • Actively participate in the entire development lifecycle, engaging in technical discussions
  • Collaborate with the Product Manager and Designer to deliver robust, scalable features.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of full-stack web development
  • Experience with React client-side development
  • Experience with Node.js server-side development
  • Understanding of web application architecture
  • Familiarity with relational or NoSQL DBs (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in computer science or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills


It would be great if you have:

  • Experience with Python
  • Experience with AWS or an alternative cloud environment
  • Experience in the mobility ecosystem
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD processes


Optibus is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background, religious beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. It is our responsibility at Optibus to provide an inclusive and accessible interview experience for all. We will provide reasonable accommodations for all candidates in need of individualised support during the hiring process.

title: Senior Data Visualization Engineer
description:
Senior Data Visualization Engineer (Tableau & Databricks Specialist)



Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Data Visualization Engineer.



Role Overview


We are seeking a highly autonomous Senior Data Visualization Engineer to lead our business intelligence efforts. As the sole subject matter expert in this space, you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of high-impact dashboards—from architectural design in Databricks to final visualization in Tableau .

This is a “team of one” role. You will be the primary consultant to our leadership team, translating complex data into actionable insights without the need for day-to-day technical oversight.



Key Responsibilities


  • End-to-End Ownership: Design, develop, and maintain automated, scalable dashboards and reports.
  • Data Engineering: Write and optimize complex SQL queries within Databricks to transform raw data into performant gold-layer tables.
  • Architecture: Establish best practices for data modeling and dashboard performance tuning to ensure fast load times for large datasets.
  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate directly with stakeholders to define KPIs and requirements, acting as both the strategist and the executor.
  • Self-Management: Manage the full project lifecycle, including documentation, testing, and deployment, with complete independence.



Required Qualifications


  • Expert Tableau Skills: 5+ years of experience building advanced visualizations (LOD expressions, complex parameters, and API integrations).
  • Databricks Mastery: Proficiency in using Databricks for data processing, including strong SQL skills and familiarity with Delta Lake architecture.
  • Data Modeling: Proven ability to build “analysis-ready” data structures—you know how to join and aggregate data for maximum dashboard efficiency.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A track record of standing up BI functions or working as a solo contributor in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: The ability to explain technical data concepts to non-technical executives clearly and concisely.



Preferred Skills


  • Experience with Tableau Server/Online administration.
  • Knowledge of Python or PySpark for advanced data manipulation.
  • Certifications in Tableau Desktop or Databricks Data Engineering.



Why this role is different

Because you will be our only Tableau expert, you won’t be bogged down by “design by committee.” You will have total creative and technical ownership over our BI roadmap and the opportunity to define how this company sees its data.



Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.


Kindly note that CVs must be submitted in English.

title: Procurement Associate
description:
Position: Procurement Associate

Location: Remote

Contract Position


We are seeking a Tactical Buyer / Procurement Specialist with hands-on experience in direct materials or purchased finished goods, ideally within nonwovens, personal care products, or tissue products.

Summary

In this role, you will support procurement operations with a strong focus on supply continuity, order processing, and project execution. You will troubleshoot purchase order issues, coordinate with internal partners, and work closely with suppliers to ensure timely, accurate, and cost-effective delivery of goods and services.

Commercial negotiations and contract ownership remain with the Category Manager(s); this role is primarily administrative and transactional with significant stakeholder and supplier interaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and troubleshoot purchase orders, including resolving pricing discrepancies, delivery delays, invoicing or payment issues, and quality concerns.
  • Monitor and support raw material supply mitigations and other supply continuity activities.
  • Serve as a liaison between business teams, Procurement, and suppliers for projects and orders.
  • Maintain structured, accurate records across systems, documents, and trackers.
  • Build and maintain effective supplier relationships, ensuring alignment on expectations, performance metrics, and scorecards.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for supplier collaboration and process improvements.
  • Use ERP systems (SAP, Coupa) and Microsoft Office to manage orders, scorecards, reports, and other procurement activities.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to support project timelines and deliverables.
  • Apply basic project management principles to track progress, flag risks, and help drive issue resolution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience as a Tactical Buyer or in a similar procurement role.
  • Background in Procurement supporting direct materials or purchased finished goods (nonwoven, personal care, or tissue products a plus).
  • Experience working with suppliers/vendors and handling supplier communications.
  • Experience with ERP systems required; SAP or Coupa experience strongly preferred (Coupa highly valued).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word).
  • Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Project management experience or exposure is a plus

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency
  • Proficiency with dental practice management software (e.g., Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or similar)
  • Ability to pass job-specific assessments


Benefits:


Personal:

  • Be a valued leader, not just a trainer

You will be recognized as a core member of our management and administrative team, with a direct impact on how our organization grows and succeeds.


  • Make a real difference at scale

Your work supports more than 15,000 dental offices , and every agent you train helps practices run better every single day.


  • Work with a mission-driven team

You’ll collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about quality, structure, and doing things the right way.


  • 100% remote – work from home

Enjoy the freedom of working from home, avoiding traffic, long commutes, and unnecessary daily stress.


  • Better work-life balance

While many companies are pushing employees back into the office, this role continues to offer a remote environment that supports focus, flexibility, and balance.


  • Stability and long-term growth

Join a well-established organization with over 15 years in business and a clear vision for continued growth.


Professional:

  • Grow your training and leadership skills

Strengthen your ability to train, coach, and develop high-performing teams at scale.


  • Work with industry leaders in dental

Collaborate with experienced leaders and professionals across the dental and revenue cycle management space.


  • Exposure to cutting-edge dental RCM technology

Learn and work with modern dental billing, revenue cycle, and automation tools used across thousands of practices.


  • Build and lead teams

Gain the opportunity to lead training cohorts and support the development of future supervisors and managers.


  • Expand your industry network

Meet and work with new people across the dental industry, growing your professional connections.


  • Develop enterprise-level experience

Be part of an organization that supports over 15,000 dental offices, giving you experience at scale that stands out on your resume.

title: Dental Insurance Posting Agent
description:
If you thrive on accuracy, move with urgency, and take pride in making sure every dollar is posted correctly and every discrepancy is resolved, this role was made for you.


As a Dental Insurance Posting Agent, you’ll be at the core of our revenue cycle operations. You’ll ensure that every insurance payment, adjustment, and denial is posted accurately and reconciled promptly, helping protect the financial health of our organization while supporting a smooth experience for patients and providers. Every payment you apply, every discrepancy you investigate, and every balance you resolve directly impacts cash flow, reporting accuracy, and overall client satisfaction.


About iCore


iCore is a dentist-led healthcare company with more than 15 years of experience supporting dental and healthcare practices nationwide. We combine secure, cloud-based technology with hands-on practice management services to help practices run stronger clinical and administrative operations.

We are more than a software company. iCoreConnect partners directly with practices to support revenue cycle management, billing, insurance verification, compliance, analytics, and day-to-day operational workflows. Our approach is built on real-world experience and a deep understanding of how practices actually function.

Behind iCoreConnect is a thriving, collaborative team of clinicians, operational experts, technologists, and customer success professionals who work together to help our clients succeed. We’re proud to be a leading company built by dentists, for dentists — focused on partnership, accountability, and long-term impact.


Mission: To give dental teams one connected platform that lets them focus on exceptional patient care.


Vision: Building the leading technology-enabled dental management platform through excellence in service, automation, and measurable results.


Core Values: Excellence, Accountability, Client Success, Teamwork, Innovation.


Objectives:


  • Review, generate, and explain patient statements, invoices, and outstanding balances
  • Communicate with patients via phone, email, or portal to address billing questions, payment plans, and disputes
  • Post patient payments accurately (credit cards, checks, EFTs) and reconcile accounts
  • Verify insurance payments and apply adjustments, co-pays, deductibles, and write-offs as appropriate
  • Collaborate with insurance billing and posting teams to ensure balances are accurate and up to date
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies or misapplied payments
  • Set up and monitor patient payment plans in accordance with office policies
  • Maintain detailed and accurate documentation in the practice management system
  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA and internal billing procedures
  • Provide professional, empathetic service to patients, including handling escalated or sensitive billing concerns


Competencies:

  • Prior experience in dental billing, patient accounts, or dental revenue cycle management
  • Working knowledge of dental insurance plans, EOBs, co-insurance, deductibles, and coordination of benefits
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-service mindset
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data entry
  • Ability to manage high call volume and multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively.
  • Full English proficiency

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
Company Description

Empregos.com.br is one of Brazil's premier job and career platforms, connecting professionals with employment opportunities and providing career guidance and training. With over 180,000 job offers from 80,000 companies and a database of more than 1 million resumes, the platform serves as a key resource for job seekers and employers. The service is free for companies to post job openings or search for candidates, aiding in creating meaningful connections in the job market. Empregos.com.br is committed to bridging the gap between talent and opportunity in Brazil.


Role Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level or Senior Frontend Developer to work directly on building and evolving our digital products.


What you will do on a daily basis:

Develop and enhance frontend applications using Vue.js and Nuxt.js

Work with SSR (Server-Side Rendering), technical SEO, and web performance

Consume and integrate REST APIs

Continuously improve Core Web Vitals and search engine indexation

Participate in technical decisions and frontend architecture evolution

Work in agile cycles, with frequent deliveries and constant feedback

Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to deliver high-impact solutions


What we expect from you:

Solid experience with Vue.js and/or Nuxt.js

SEO is not a plus — it’s mandatory (rendering, indexing, performance)

Experience consuming Web APIs

Experience with CI/CD pipelines

Experience with Docker containers

Strong knowledge of Git

Ability to translate design into pixel-perfect, high-performance interfaces

Agile mindset: prioritization, short delivery cycles, and continuous improvement


Nice to have:


Experience working on high-traffic projects

Strong knowledge of frontend performance optimization

Previous experience with SEO-driven products


What we offer:


100% remote work

Technical autonomy and space for decision-making

A product with real impact and scale

A collaborative environment where we learn and grow together

Contractor agreement (PJ)


If you enjoy solving real problems, working at scale, optimizing SEO and performance, and growing alongside a living product, this opportunity is for you!

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, CLT model and salary range is 14k-20k BRL/mo (DOE).


Must Haves:

  • 3+ years of Java development experience (Java 17+ preferred)
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot
  • Proven experience supporting and maintaining large legacy systems
  • Excellent communication skills; proactive, collaborative, and user‑focused


Plusses:

  • Exposure to search technologies (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Apache Solr)
  • Experience with Python and Airflow (orchestration)
  • Experience with AWS cloud services
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized environments


Day‑to‑Day:

As a member of this squad, you’ll focus on maintaining and supporting legacy search platforms that power at least five internal products. The role centers on working within a large, established codebase—resolving bugs, responding to outages, and ensuring overall system stability and reliability. While new feature development is limited, you’ll occasionally handle enhancement requests as needed. This role prioritizes quality, thoughtful problem‑solving, and strong communication over speed. You’ll collaborate closely with internal users, frequently engaging via Slack and participating in regular team discussions. Mid‑level engineers will primarily focus on ticket execution, while senior engineers will dive into more complex issues and mentor others—playing a key role in keeping critical systems running smoothly and efficiently.

Innodata is a leading global data engineering and AI solutions company, trusted by 4 out of 5 of the world’s largest technology companies . With operations across 13 global locations and a workforce of 5,000+ professionals , we support industries including technology, finance, insurance, law, and healthcare .

We are excited to expand our AI & Machine Learning Talent Network and are currently looking for detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data and want to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this opportunity is for you.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material)
  • Ensure high levels of data accuracy, consistency, and quality
  • Support the creation of AI training datasets for next-generation systems
  • Provide feedback and insights to improve workflows and processes


Requirements:

  • Minimum qualification: Bachelor’s degree (or higher)
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal)
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills
  • Comfortable working with diverse and varied content types
  • Access to a secure, private workspace with stable internet connectivity
  • Current Location: Brazil , Native Country: Brazil , Language: Portuguese


Why Join Innodata?

  • Be part of a global AI-driven organization
  • Contribute directly to cutting-edge AI and ML technologies
  • Work with an experienced, diverse, and forward-thinking team
  • Gain exposure to real-world, large-scale AI systems

title: Applied Scientist
description:
Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML – Pricing)

We are looking for a highly accomplished Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML) with a strong research background and deep expertise in machine learning to develop and deploy advanced pricing and price optimization solutions. This role requires a combination of research excellence and hands-on production experience, translating complex real-world business problems into scalable machine learning systems.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals passionate about applied research, advanced machine learning, and delivering high-impact AI solutions at scale.


Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop advanced machine learning and statistical models for pricing and price optimization.
  • Translate complex business problems into mathematical and algorithmic solutions.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to generate actionable insights and improve pricing strategies.
  • Build, validate, and deploy scalable ML/DL models in production environments.
  • Apply advanced techniques including optimization, forecasting, and causal inference.
  • Develop clean, efficient, and production-grade code.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions and deployable products.
  • Contribute to intellectual property through research publications and conference presentations.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentor junior team members.


Required Qualifications (Mandatory)

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
  • Proven research background with publications in recognized scientific journals
  • Experience presenting research at industry or academic conferences
  • 5+ years of experience in applied Machine Learning
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices including experiment design, A/B testing, feature engineering, and training/serving pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, or Keras
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and data engineering workflows
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure )


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying ML to pricing, optimization, forecasting, recommender systems, personalization, computer vision, fraud detection, or marketing analytics
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and ML lifecycle management
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Demonstrated leadership or mentoring experience

Auxiliar de Loja - Shopping Campo Grande | (Afirmativa para Pessoas com Deficiência)

O que estamos buscando?

Procuramos profissionais com conhecimento em produtos e serviços, além de habilidades sólidas em organização e gestão de tarefas, para colaborar com a equipe de loja.

  • Apoio na precificação dos produtos;
  • É responsável por cumprir com as políticas, regras e normas de Segurança do Trabalho e Saúde ocupacional de seu local ou processo de trabalho.
